operating_notes.text: Automotive segment contributed ₹750.77 Cr of Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹751.25 Cr; the Others (LED) segment was ₹0.48 Cr.
An estimated insurance claim of ₹82.30 Cr for the Unit-8 Tapukara fire was submitted to the insurer on January 30, 2026, with settlement still pending.
FY26 capex was ₹125.88 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹161.28 Cr.
Q4 & FY26 earnings call audio recording made available.
FY26 LED share of automotive lighting was 63%, up from 60% last year, and management said the new business pipeline is almost 100% LED.
Capacity utilisation is around 75%, with FY26 capex of ₹108.31 Cr used to debottleneck lines.
Of ₹700 Cr of 4-wheeler RFQs, 70% is converted into business but not yet into fixed orders.

timeline.summary: J.K. Jain, Seema Jain, Aanchal Jain, and Rahul Jain declared no new encumbrances by Fiem Industries Ltd. promoters for FY2026 on 04/04/2026.
Vineet Sahni resigned as CEO and Whole-time Director of Fiem Industries.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹751.25 Cr (+17.5% YoY), net profit ₹71.03 Cr (+20.7% YoY).
Vineet Sahni ceased to be CEO and Whole-time Director of Fiem Industries effective May 31, 2026.
Fiem Industries released its Q4 & FY26 earnings presentation and announced board-level leadership changes.
Fiem Industries hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call and published the audio recording link on June 1, 2026.

Fiem Industries' Q4 & FY26 earnings call (June 1, 2026) guided FY27 revenue growth of 15-20% and EBITDA margin of about 14%, with 4-wheeler revenue of ₹100-150 Cr in FY27 rising to ₹200-250 Cr in FY28.
